text:
Ariane: Heads up — saw a billing spike in the canary yesterday, seems tied to toolcall retries + stream truncation when we fell back regions.
Chang: link to trace?
Ariane: putting stripped logs below. req=rz-7f1, client_session=cs-91, toolcall_id=tc-42. Server emitted EOF (truncated chunk) then client retried and got routed to a different region. Both attempts generated provisional token credits and both eventually got confirmed.
Sam: ouch. paste logs pls (sanitized)
Ariane: ```
[INFO] 2026-03-22T23:11:12Z req=rz-7f1 route=us-east-1 X-Route-Tag: prefer-lowcost toolcall_id=tc-42 client_session=cs-91 truncated_after_tokens=1198 provisional_tokens=1200
[INFO] 2026-03-22T23:11:15Z req=rz-7f1 retry-> routed to us-west-2 route=us-west-2 toolcall_id= (missing) client_session=cs-91 provisional_tokens=1200
[INFO] 2026-03-22T23:11:20Z ack confirmed tokens for both sessions -> ledger credited 2400 tokens
```
Nina: Wait — server dedup is by toolcall_id right? If second attempt lacked toolcall_id the system couldn't dedupe.
Chang: yup. The truncation path marks the first session's tokens as provisional until we receive final confirmation (final chunk/ack). When the client retries without an idempotency token and gets routed to a different region, the fallback route creates a fresh provisional allocation. If both branches get confirmed due to race, double-bill.
Sam: Is this unique to toolcalls or streaming generically?
Ariane: most visible for toolcalls because tool responses are longer and more likely to truncate mid-stream, but streaming text can hit same pattern.
Nina: two remediation axes: short-term alert + reconcile job, long-term API change to carry an explicit flow id across routing/fallbacks.
Chang: propose header X-Redwood-Flow-Id (or X-RD-Flow-Id) that gateway/gossip copies when routing/falling-back so downstream ledgers can attribute credits to the same flow even across regions.
Sam: +1 for explicit flow id. Also want telemetry: emit provisional_source metadata (route, origin_region, flow_id) so console can show provisional vs confirmed delta per route.
Nina: console UX idea — add a "provisional leak" column on per-route billing dashboard and a toggle that shows only sessions with provisional==confirmed discrepancies in the last 24h.
Chang: alternate idea: heuristic dedupe at ledger level if client_session+model+prompt hash matches within X seconds. That avoids requiring client changes.
Sam: heuristics are brittle — false positives could under-bill. Prefer explicit flow id and short TTL dedupe as defense-in-depth.
Ariane: For immediate mitigation: 1) add Grafana alert for sudden uptick in "confirmed_tokens / provisional_tokens > 0.95" per route (i.e., spikes where provisional->confirmed jumps), 2) run reconciliation job to find toolcall_id collisions across regions and issue credits/refunds.
Nina: I'll open a small PR to add provisional_source tags to telemetry (trace + metrics) and a console flag to surface provisional/confirmed counts. Sam can you draft an incident runbook for the alert?
Sam: Yup — will draft runbook, and add metric "provisional_tokens_percent_by_route". Also will add an ops play: when alert fires, snapshot traces for requests in the window and run dedupe-check.
Chang: we should also add unit + e2e harness simulating fallback with truncated stream and absent idempotency header to prevent regressions.
Ariane: good. Who owns the flow-id header change? Nina? Chang?
Nina: I can shepherd the telemetry + console PRs. Chang — want to own the internal API header + gateway copy logic?
Chang: I can. I'll also add validation to reject requests without flow-id in the new canary if we decide to require it.
Ariane: Action items: Nina -> telemetry + console flag PR. Chang -> internal API + gateway copy, test harness. Sam -> alert runbook + reconciliation job draft. I'll put a quick ticket for immediate reconcile and tag billing-ops.
devbot: incident created: #billing-ops C-2026-42 (auto)
Sam: pinging @Nina @Chang for review on the runbook when ready.
Nina: noted. Also recommend adding a small dashboard widget showing percent of toolcalls missing toolcall_id or flow_id (helps catch clients that don't send idempotency headers).
Chang: good call. We'll add that to the canary dashboard.
Ariane: thanks all — this explains the spike. we'll coordinate PRs and follow up in this thread. @Sam @Nina @Chang
